{{Top|leg}}
'''Seb Lorod''' was an individual who formed a relationship with [[Kaliyo Djannis]], who eventually gained his trust. Despite promising Seb to open a club together, Kaliyo eventually left him without an explanation, departing for [[Zakuul]]. Seb feared that Kaliyo was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], yet patiently waited for her for two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] until she resurfaced again, at which point he finally realized that she was conning him all along.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=10}}</ref>
